findings.description: Ensure the API server audit log retention is set to at least thirty days
Ensure the admission plugin list includes PodSecurityPolicy
Ensure the key-value store peer connections use client certificate authentication
Ensure the kubelet rejects anonymous requests on its read-only port
Minimise admission of privileged containers (formerly enforced by PodSecurityPolicy, now by the policy engine)
Ensure the kubelet service file ownership is root:root
Apply a security context to pods and containers
Ensure the API server manifest permissions are restrictive
Ensure anonymous authentication is disabled on the kubelet
